 November 5, 2026 06:42 PM 
 Written by benji_cs2 
 Iowa Stormboar's H0NeST breaks into HLTV Top 50 Prospects at #33
 The Ukrainian rifler was just outside the top 50 last month. 
 The HLTV Top 50 Prospects list for November dropped today, with Nazar "⁠H0NeST⁠" Stefinko making a splash this month. The Ukrainian rifler, who plays for Iowa Stormboar in NA, has made his debut on the prospects list, coming in at #33.
 Also returning to the list from the previous month are the Marsborne duo of Chance "WUMBO" Boyer and Bogdan "ogwizard" Savula at 44th and 45th, respectively. Liquid AWPer Georgi "⁠Jorko⁠" Mitev moved closer to the top five, moving up two places from ninth to seventh.
 Also read: 1win, BC.Game promise players Rolls-Royces if they win the Singapore Major 
 H0NeST has been in fine form this year, averaging a 1.26 rating in 93 maps over the past six months, during which he has suited up for ex-Aether, regain, and Iowa Stormboar.
 Compared to the rest of the top 50 prospects, the Ukrainian rifler has the most net kills against both eco and buy rounds of all riflers in the past six months.
 Internationally, the only NA-adjacent top prospect playing at the upcoming PGL Major Singapore is Jorko, who will make his Major debut at the event. Liquid will start the Major in Stage 1, alongside fellow NA sides M80 and Wildcard.
